workspace.alt: The HaloDeck editor with a marked-up dashboard screenshot on the slide and a rectangle selected
workspace.caption: The editor with one slide open and a rectangle selected.
legend: Top bar. Undo, the drawing tools, Paste, the deck's name, Help, Open, Save project and Export.
Slides. Every slide in the deck. Click to open one, drag to reorder.
The slide. Your canvas. Everything you draw sits on top of what's already there, as its own layer.
Floating toolbar. Appears over whatever you select: duplicate, bring to front, send to back, lock, delete.
Right panel. Properties of the selected item, then Layers, then Slide settings further down.
Slide and zoom bar. Previous / next slide, zoom out and in, and FIT to see the whole slide.

topbar_left.alt: Left half of the top bar: brand, undo and redo, the five tools, insert images and Paste

topbar_right.alt: Right half of the top bar: deck name, save status, Help, Open, Save project and Export

menu_open.alt: The Open menu: PDF, Photos and HaloDeck project
menu_open.caption: Open ▾ in the top bar.

dialog_paste.alt: Paste box with a dashed target area that says Press Ctrl+V
dialog_paste.caption: The paste box, when the browser won't hand over the clipboard by itself.

dialog_pdf.alt: Open PDF as slides dialog showing page previews, page choice, slide size, where to put the slides and the notes option
dialog_pdf.caption: Opening a 3-page US Letter PDF.
legend: Pages. All, or a list like 1-3, 7.
Slide size. Match the PDF makes the slides the PDF's own shape. Keep this deck's size fits each page inside your current slides.
Put them in a new deck (named after the file) or this deck, after the slide you're on.
Copy each page's text into its slide notes. Keeps the PDF's words as real text in HTML exports.

dialog_photos.alt: Photos as slides dialog with four photo previews and options for slide size, fit and order
dialog_photos.caption: Adding four photos to the open deck.
legend: Slide size. Match the photos' shape, or keep this deck's size.
Show it whole fits each photo inside the slide; Fill the slide crops to cover it edge to edge.
Order. By file name (IMG_2 before IMG_10) or the order you picked them.

drawing.alt: A red circle being dragged out over the 'Orders this week' card of the screenshot
drawing.caption: Drawing a circle straight on top of the pasted screenshot. You don't need empty space to start a shape.
legend: Drag from one corner to the other. Hold <kbd>Shift</kbd> for a perfect circle.

toolbar_active.alt: The tool buttons with the circle tool highlighted
legend: The highlighted tool stays on after each shape. Press <kbd>Esc</kbd> or <kbd>V</kbd> to go back to Select.

selected.alt: A selected rectangle with square resize handles, a round rotate handle and the floating toolbar above it
selected.caption: A selected rectangle.
legend: Drag a square handle to resize. Images keep their shape; hold <kbd>Shift</kbd> to change that.
Drag the round handle to rotate. <kbd>Shift</kbd> snaps to 15°.
The floating toolbar for the selection.

editing.alt: Text box in typing mode with a dashed outline
editing.caption: A text box being edited. The dashed outline means you're typing.
legend: Click anywhere in the text to put the cursor there. <kbd>Esc</kbd> or a click outside finishes.

ctxmenu_layer.alt: Right-click menu on a text layer: Edit text, Cut, Copy, Paste, Duplicate, Bring to front, Send to back, Lock, Delete
ctxmenu_layer.caption: Right-click on a layer.

ctxmenu_blank.alt: Right-click menu on empty space: Paste here, Add text here, Insert images
ctxmenu_blank.caption: Right-click on empty space.

panel_style.alt: Properties panel for a text box: Text, Font, Size, Color, bold and italic, alignment, background behind text
panel_style.caption: Properties for a text box.
legend: Text. Type here instead of on the slide if that's easier (handy on a phone).
Font and Size.
Bold, italic and alignment.
Background behind text. Raise it to put a label on a solid backing so it reads over a busy screenshot.

panel_layers.alt: Layers list with a grip, edit, show/hide, lock and delete buttons on each row
panel_layers.caption: The Layers list, top layer first.
legend: Drag the grip (or the whole row with a mouse) to change the order.
Edit a text layer.
Hide or show.
Lock: the layer can't be moved by accident and clicks pass through it to whatever is underneath.
Delete.

panel_slides.alt: Slides panel with three slide thumbnails, buttons on the hovered slide, and Add slide at the bottom
panel_slides.caption: The Slides panel.
legend: The slide that's open. Drag thumbnails to reorder.
Duplicate or delete a slide (shown when you point at it).
Add slide adds a blank slide after the current one.
Photos as slides. Pick several photos, one slide each.

panel_slide.alt: Slide settings: page size, background color, background image, notes, and Add notes to slide
panel_slide.caption: Slide settings.
legend: Page size. Applies to every slide; what's on them is scaled to fit.
Background color for this slide.
Background image. Fills the slide behind everything.
Notes & commentary. Exported as real text under the slide.
Put the notes on the slide as a text box.

menu_export.alt: The Export menu: HTML, PNG and PDF
menu_export.caption: Export ▾.

dialog_export.alt: Export dialog with HTML, PNG and PDF cards, PDF options, slide selection set to 1-2 and thumbnails
dialog_export.caption: Exporting slides 1 and 2 as a PDF.
legend: Format. You can still switch here.
Options for the chosen format.
All, Current (the slide you're on) or Clear.
Custom. Type slide numbers like 1-3, 5. It stays in sync with the thumbnails.
Click thumbnails to add or remove slides. <kbd>Shift</kbd>-click picks a run.
The button says exactly what you'll get.

viewer.alt: An exported HTML deck open in a browser, showing slide 1 with its notes underneath
viewer.caption: An exported HTML deck, opened straight from the downloaded file.
legend: Previous / next. Arrow keys, <kbd>Space</kbd>, <kbd>Home</kbd>, <kbd>End</kbd> and swiping also work.
All slides on one page (<kbd>A</kbd>).
Full screen for presenting (<kbd>F</kbd>). Click the right or left side of the slide to move on or back.
Slide notes, as real text.

phone_editor.alt: HaloDeck on a phone: slide in the middle, tools along the bottom
phone_editor.caption: The editor on a phone.
legend: Slides.
More: Paste, PDF and photos as slides, Open, Save project, Help.
Tools along the bottom, plus the Layers & style button at the right end.

phone_sheet.alt: Phone with the Style sheet open at the bottom showing the text box's settings
phone_sheet.caption: Style, Layers and Slide open as a sheet from the bottom.
legend: Switch between Style, Layers and Slide.

phone_hold.alt: Phone showing the menu opened by touching and holding the picture on the slide
phone_hold.caption: Touch and hold for the same menu a right-click opens.

help_panel.caption: Help inside HaloDeck (the ? button or the ? key).

tour_welcome.alt: The tour's welcome screen with two choices: I make decks, and I set HaloDeck up for others
tour_welcome.caption: The first time someone opens HaloDeck.

tour_whatsnew.alt: What's new after an update: cards for each change with a type label, a picture, and a Show me button
tour_whatsnew.caption: What's new for someone who makes decks, coming back after two updates.
legend: What changed: New, Improved, Fixed, Changed. Admin-only changes are marked Admins and only shown to admins.
Show me points at the real control on screen.
Whose changes these are, with a switch for people who run HaloDeck.
Close it. It won't appear again for this version.

tour_step.alt: A tour step: screenshot with numbered markers on the left, explanation on the right, Show me button and progress dots
tour_step.caption: A step of the tour.
legend: Where you are in the tour. The left and right arrow keys move between steps.
A screenshot of this version, with numbered markers.
Show me rings the real control in the app.
Progress dots. Click one to jump to that step.

tour_showme.alt: The screen dimmed with an amber ring around the Open button and a note saying Back to the tour
tour_showme.caption: Show me, pointing at Open.

tour_admin.alt: The admin tour's Release an update step with a four-part diagram and the current build number
tour_admin.caption: From the admins' tour: releasing an update.

changelog.alt: The change log: a timeline of every HaloDeck version with dates and labelled changes
changelog.caption: The change log (Help → Change log).
legend: Show everything, changes for everyone, or admin changes only.
Oldest first, or newest first.
Download the whole log as JSON or CSV.
The version you're using.

help_role.alt: The Your role choice in Help: I make decks, or I run HaloDeck for others
help_role.caption: Your role, in Help.

move_banner.alt: A notice across the top of HaloDeck: HaloDeck is moving, with Save project and New address buttons
move_banner.caption: The notice at the old address before a move.
legend: Save project downloads the deck that's open.
Opens the new address.
